headline: Haplotype-aware graph pangenomes are reshaping variant association and genome assembly
label: Pangenome And Haplotype Resolution
summary: Haplotype-resolved assemblies and graph pangenomes now feed directly into k-mer association testing and variant calling.
synthesis: The common thread is the move from a single linear reference to haplotype-resolved or graph-based representations of genome variation. The Capsicum study applies a graph pangenome to k-mer GWAS, localizing hits and linking capsaicinoid and aroma traits to haplotypes and candidate loci. The mouse draft pangenome graph provides base-level graphs on a C57BL/6J T2T backbone, including founder and CC pangenomes, to improve read alignment and variant calling. The Rhizoctonia solani AG1-IB study reports a haplotype-resolved, chromosome-scale assembly built from Nanopore, Hi-C and PECAT data, revealing haplotype divergence in a multinucleate heterokaryotic organism. What is new is that haplotype-aware representation is applied across reference construction, association testing and read-level analysis, although the three items address different stages rather than the same analysis.
